title: The Broken Hammers
html:
Hester Bell's tools are turning up in Rustpick with their handles broken. The goblins have a use for the iron and no use for the smith who made it.

About

Given byHester Bell
Level11
LengthMedium
KindSkill
Quest points3
UnlocksThe Mace weapon skill

What you need

Not known yet: the data for this quest is incomplete.

Steps

  1. Talk to Hester Bell (outdoors near Rustpick Mine) to get the quest.
  2. Kill goblins in Rustpick Mine until you have 5 Stolen Smith Tools (a quest item).
  3. Bring them back to Hester Bell.
  4. Kill the goblins’ boss, Nib the Toolkeeper (a level 12 goblin in Rustpick Mine).
  5. Go back to Hester Bell to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold350
Character XP16,000
Mace XP279
Quest points3
ItemsIron Mace
Unlocksthe Mace weapon skill

Unlocks

The Mace weapon skill: this quest is how you learn it (the mace tome is retired). Once you have it you can wield maces, the skill levels with the damage you deal, and it unlocks five special attacks along the way.
